scope: Six current PowerShell review corrections and preserved earlier witnesses, with native generation and full x64 gates.

baseline.results: All 27 native parser outcomes recorded and all 38 native literal values matched. All four frozen Rust regressions failed with cargo exit 101; the other 29 literal tests passed. The old parser also accepted the invalid blank-before-comment pipe and rejected two valid block-comment continuations.

earlier_baseline.results: Native PowerShell recorded all 23 grammar cases and matched 32 literal values; the unchanged parser rejected valid comment/Unicode-space continuations, and both new literal-run Rust regressions failed as expected. The nested block-comment hypothesis was rejected by native PowerShell and remains a negative control.

prior_harness_failure.reason: PowerShell itself threw a format exception executing the mixed generic/verbatim Unicode near-miss. That probe did not establish a complete baseline. The near-miss was replaced with a valid standalone verbatim literal before the successful baseline.

publication: An isolated candidate only after generated byte and tree validation. Maintained PR publication requires all native gates, including ARM and lint.
